Set-Cookie: JSESSIONID=<redacted>; Max-Age=0; Expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:10 GMT; Path=/

notes: Legacy logout used by the 2.42 header bar: GET /dhis-web-commons-security/logout.action -> 302 Location '/' and invalidates the server session (subsequent /api/me with the old cookie -> 401).
SURPRISE: the Set-Cookie clears 'JSESSIONID' (default name), NOT the instance's actual cookie name JSESSIONID_agent-facility-hub; the session is still invalidated server-side.
